metadata.description: Starter scaffolding for Claude Code and Claude Cowork: process discipline, knowledge management, delegation patterns, and a personal-companion track. Works for any kind of structured work — not just coding.

plugins.name: welcome
plugins.description: Top-level marketplace orientation. One slash command (/welcome:tour) that explains in two minutes what basic-harness is, the four personas it's built for, the install flow, and points at the two specialized tours (/personal-coach:tour and /process-skills:tour). Read-only — writes nothing, invokes nothing. Recommended first install for new users.

plugins.name: process-skills
plugins.description: Six domain-agnostic process skills: brainstorming (idea → validated design), planning-projects (staged plan with gates), executing-plans (drive a plan to done with evidence-of-done), evidence-first-investigation (figure out why before proposing what), review-document (holistic 30-second-rule review), peer-review-deliverable (review what's new against a baseline). Plus /process-skills:tour for the read-only walkthrough.

plugins.name: vault-librarian
plugins.description: Companion to the upstream obsidian-wiki plugin. One cross-platform slash command (/vault-librarian:bootstrap-vault) that sets up a Markdown notes vault from inside Claude Code, with persona-tuned schema templates for researchers, writers, generalists, and personal users. No shell snippets — works on Claude Code Desktop and Claude Cowork on macOS and Windows.

plugins.name: delegation-agents
plugins.description: Three model-pinned worker subagents (bulk-reader on Haiku, document-rewriter and draft-generator on Sonnet) plus a dispatching-parallel-agents skill. Lets a parent session on Opus offload bulk reading, editing, and drafting to cheaper, faster models. Domain-agnostic — works for research, writing, project management, analysis.

plugins.name: personal-coach
plugins.description: Personal-use companion. Eight skills + three model-pinned subagents + four slash commands + four Cowork Routine templates. Roles: personal assistant with a persistent profile, reflective listener for journaling and CBT-style reframing (not therapy), business mentor with decision-journal grading, fintech legal-issue spotter for KYC/AML/PSD2/MiCA/GDPR (not legal advice), plus a personalized daily news digest tailored to user-defined topics. Multilingual — runs in whatever language you write in. Hard limits enforced everywhere: no medical/psychological diagnosis, no legal advice, no silent profile edits, no surrogate decisions, nothing leaves the machine unless you explicitly enable a Cowork Routine.
